CustomField.description: Check this box to stop the Log Console grouping repeated errors on its own. In its Problem summary view, errors that were logged without a fingerprint are gathered into one row with a count — same error, same class and method, same level — and the grouping is worked out at the moment you open the list. Check the box and Problem summary shows only the problems your developers tagged with a fingerprint in code; the list does not go empty. This setting changes what the Log Console displays, never what is logged: every entry is still written, still listed under Individual entries, and nothing is deleted. Leave it unchecked (the default) to keep the grouping on — it stays on through package upgrades until you check this box.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to stop the Log Console grouping repeated errors on its own; Problem summary then lists only the problems tagged in code. Unchecked (the default) = grouping on. Nothing is logged differently and nothing is deleted.
CustomField.label: Problem Grouping Disabled
